reviews.thesis: The long-term trend is strong and 15,705 was reclaimed, but the 10/7 surge ran directly into the repeated 17,910 high and closed well off that high; current location is too extended for a clean retest entry.
reviews.confirmation: Hold the 15,705 reclaim on a pullback and then close-accept above 17,910
reviews.chaseJudgement: Do not chase the 10/7 expansion; wait for either a 15.7k retest or clean 17.91k acceptance.
reviews.counterargument: MA20/60/120 are strongly aligned and the 10/7 volume expansion could be the start of a higher trend leg.

reviews.thesis: Price is retesting the repeatedly defended 8,080-8,260 box-floor zone after a weak low-location close; the level is close enough for asymmetric testing, but the broader trend remains below declining MA20/60/120.
reviews.confirmation: Defend 8,080-8,210 and recover 8,515-8,585 on closing basis
reviews.chaseJudgement: Only attractive near the box floor; a rebound chased above 8,550 loses the location advantage.
reviews.counterargument: 10/7 closed near the session low and all major medium-term averages remain overhead.

reviews.thesis: The uptrend is intact and 57,500 has been reclaimed, but price has advanced for several sessions into a fresh high with RSI near 70 and bearish divergence while the nearest accepted support is materially lower.
reviews.confirmation: A controlled retest that holds 56,500-57,500 followed by renewed close acceptance above 58,800
reviews.chaseJudgement: Current high-zone extension is not an asymmetric fresh entry.
reviews.counterargument: The 10/7 close was near the high and MA20/60/120 alignment remains strongly constructive.

reviews.thesis: The 20,000 box-floor has absorbed repeated tests and 10/7 again closed just above it; this is a defined-risk support test, though the broader trend remains below MA20/60/120.
reviews.confirmation: Hold 20,000 and recover 20,745-21,285, with stronger confirmation above 21,700
reviews.chaseJudgement: Probe only at the 20k floor; do not chase into 21.7k-23.45k overhead supply.
reviews.counterargument: 10/7 was a low-location bearish session and repeated support tests can exhaust the 20k floor.

reviews.thesis: The primary trend is powerful but the September-October run is extended far above MA20/60/120; 10/7 rejected from 13,800 and RSI remains above 70, leaving no nearby structural invalidation.
reviews.confirmation: Orderly pullback that holds the 11.9k accepted-support area and then reclaims 13,280-13,800
reviews.chaseJudgement: Current 13.4k area is a chase after a multi-week expansion.
reviews.counterargument: Trend alignment and sustained trading-value expansion can keep momentum elevated longer than expected.

reviews.thesis: The 302,500 multi-test box floor remains the nearest structural support and offers defined downside, but 10/7 reversed lower from 315,500 and price remains under MA20/60 and dense 316.5k-334.5k overhead supply.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Only a support-location probe is justified; chasing a rebound into 316.5k-334.5k is unattractive.
reviews.counterargument: A decisive loss of 301k would break the repeated floor and invalidate the support thesis.

reviews.thesis: Price is sitting on the 32,800 box floor, but the broader structure is still a persistent downtrend below MA20/60/120/240 and 10/7 closed near the low without a reversal signal.
reviews.confirmation: Hold 32,800 and close back above 33,500, then clear 34,427
reviews.chaseJudgement: No chase; this requires reversal confirmation because the support test is occurring inside a dominant downtrend.
reviews.counterargument: The tight invalidation at the box floor can create good asymmetry if 32.8k produces an immediate reversal.

reviews.thesis: The long-term uptrend remains constructive, but price is in the middle of a broad decision area around 100k-103.4k with only modest room to the 108.7k-109.7k box resistance and no compelling structural R/R.
reviews.confirmation: Sustain above 103,400 and then close-accept above 109,200, or retest 98k support cleanly
reviews.chaseJudgement: Current mid-range location does not justify chasing.
reviews.counterargument: MA20/60/120 remain positively aligned and the 10/7 close recovered toward the session high.

reviews.thesis: The 68,480 box-floor/event-close cluster remains accepted support and 10/7 tested it with expanded activity; the location is defined, but the sharp upper rejection requires recovery confirmation.
reviews.confirmation: Hold 68,480 and recover 69,900-71,700; stronger confirmation above 73,600
reviews.chaseJudgement: Probe only close to 68.5k support; do not chase into 71.7k-75.8k breakdown supply.
reviews.counterargument: 10/7 fell from 73,600 to a near-low close on high relative volume, which may signal distribution rather than support.

reviews.thesis: The 107.6k support remains intact, but 10/7 rejected the 114.9k area and closed near the low inside a broad 109.35k-114.37k decision zone; immediate direction is unresolved.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Wait for support retest or reclaim; the current decision-zone close is not a clean entry.
reviews.counterargument: MA60/120 remain below price and the July-August recovery structure has not structurally failed.

reviews.thesis: The 80.4k-82.4k event-close/swing cluster is a meaningful role-reversal support after the September breakout; 10/7 closed weakly but still held the zone, giving a defined retest setup.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Only probe around the support cluster; a rebound chased near 88.5k has compressed reward.
reviews.counterargument: Three sessions of failure near 89k followed by a low-location 10/7 close may be an early failed-breakout sequence.

reviews.thesis: The early-October spring from 129k remains valid, but the rebound has already moved into the 132.5k-143.9k decision/supply zone and current reward to 143.9k is compressed.
reviews.confirmation: Hold 133,600 on pullback and close-accept above 143,900; alternatively retest 129.8k support cleanly
reviews.chaseJudgement: Do not chase the rebound inside the decision zone; wait for retest or 143.9k acceptance.
reviews.counterargument: The 129k spring and recovery above MA60/120/240 can develop into a broader base reversal if 143.9k is cleared.
